name: Telegram Send File
description: Send a current-session artifact to the active Telegram chat as a photo or document. Available only during Telegram turns.

function.name: telegram_send_file
function.description: Deliver an artifact to the user in this Telegram chat/topic. First use save_artifact to save a screenshot, image, report, PDF, or other file, then call this with its filename. Saving an artifact or embedding /api URLs does NOT send it to Telegram. Destination is fixed to this turn; you cannot choose a chat or session. Success confirms Telegram accepted the upload. Auto sends PNG/JPEG images up to 10 MB as photos; other files are documents (50 MB limit). Use kind=document to preserve the original image without compression.

filename.description: Basename returned by save_artifact in the current session, e.g. screenshot.png or report.md. No paths or URLs.

caption.description: Optional plain-text caption, up to 1024 characters.

kind.description: Default auto. Use photo for a screenshot/image preview; document for an uncompressed file.
